text:
marta: FYI paging started at ~1845123456 from incident-bot — high p50/p95 token latency on hosted-api, customers seeing timeouts. I started a thread to capture mitigation + follow-ups.

incident-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api.latency.p95 > 1200ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Pager sent to @sam. Incident ID: INC-2026-042.

sam: On it. I'm switching to oncall now. Any customer-facing errors?

marta: A few 502s bubbled up in support queue, but majority are downstream timeouts to runtime pool. We toggled fallback routing at 1845123480 to a smaller but lower-latency model variant — cut error spike by ~40%.

lee: Logs show a surge of long seq requests from a single customer job hitting beam-search path. Throttling that job reduced inflight KV cache usage.

priya: Good call. We should tune alerts to avoid noisy paging on noisy customer backfills. Current p95 alert is too sensitive.

sam: Live mitigation notes: 1) throttled suspect API key 2) enabled model-variant fallback 3) increased dedicated autoscale headroom by +10%. Those reduced latency to ~700ms p95, still above 500ms SLO.

marta: Retrospective action: update Grafana incident dashboard to make drilldowns for: per-customer long-seq volume, per-model kv-cache evictions, and request size distribution. Current dashboard lacks a per-customer panel which slowed triage.

dash-builder: I'll start a dashboard PR. Suggest panels:
- Golden signals row: request rate, p50/p95 latency, error rate (4xx/5xx)
- Heatmap: p95 latency by model variant (rows) x region (cols)
- Table: top 20 API keys by average seq length and p95 latency
- KV cache metrics: hit rate, evictions/s, memory utilization
- Alert status row: active alerts + last fire

sam: For alert tuning proposals:
- Change p95 threshold from 1200ms -> 1500ms for global paging, add a 5-minute suppression window for transient spikes.
- Add a second alert: sustained p95 > 900ms for 10m that fires to channel only (no page) for faster visibility.
- Create per-customer noisy-job suppression if a single API key accounts for >50% of long-seq requests for 5m.

priya: Agree. Also add an eval panel that visualizes fraction of requests that exceed SLO per 1m bucket, to see long-tail behavior.

lee: Draft PromQL snippets for new panels/alerts (for Grafana / Alertmanager):

```
# p95 latency by model variant
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"hosted-api\"}[5m])) by (le, model_variant))

# per-api-key long-seq rate
sum(rate(requests_total{job=\"hosted-api\", seq_len=~\"[5-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9]{2,}\"}[5m])) by (api_key)

# kv cache evictions per second
sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total{job=\"runtime\"}[1m])) by (instance)
```

marta: Nice. For the dashboard layout let's have a top-level filter row with time range + api_key + model_variant so we can quickly zoom in. Also add links from table rows to logs (LogQL link) and to runbook.

dash-builder: Plan for panel configs in PR: panel IDs, data sources, templating variables, and panel thresholds with annotation events when alerts fire. I'll include drilldown links and an exported JSON snippet for the ops playbook.

sam: Ownership & timeline: dash-builder to open a PR by EOD tomorrow; eng-sre to review. Priya / Lee to draft tuned alert rules. Marta to update incident postmortem with timeline + customer-impact summary.

priya: One more: add a noise-mitigation cookbook entry describing how to detect and throttle noisy customers (promql, recommended rate limits, and example curl commands to block). That will speed next time.

lee: After the dashboard is live we should run a synthetic test to ensure panels and alerts fire appropriately. I can spin up a test job that simulates long seq traffic and confirm suppression logic.

marta: Customer impact note for PMs: ~12 customers saw degraded experience; 3 had transient 502s for ~7 minutes. Support has a canned message ready.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status updated -> mitigated, assigned to follow-up.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll capture alert thresholds in the PR comments. Follow-ups:
- PR: grafana/dashboard/ops/1845123456-alert-tuning (dash-builder)
- Alerts: propose new rule file and suppression logic (priya/lee)
- Postmortem + runbook updates (marta)

marta: Adding owner tags in the postmortem for each action. Closing thread for live ops; move design discussion to the dashboard PR. :thumbsup:
